operations.description: Count of vessels visible on AIS in the Persian Gulf window whose identity matches an OFAC SDN entry (IMO / normalised-name join; false positives possible). Cross-join every 15 minutes; per-vessel detail is premium data.

Multiple over the peace-baseline VLCC premium, per-voyage cost in USD from peacetime baseline to current crisis high, and the P&I clubs / war-risk underwriters that have withdrawn cover, imposed quotas, or refused renewals. Hand-curated; timestamp refreshed weekly.

EIA/IEA shares of global seaborne oil and LNG transiting the strait, a curated daily economic-cost estimate, the most-affected importing economies, and extra Cape-reroute voyage days. Hand-curated; refreshed weekly.

Marine war-risk high-risk areas from the Lloyd's Joint War Committee circular, plus a flag for whether the latest revision mentions the Arabian Gulf. Drives war-risk premium loads at most London-market underwriters. Re-checked every 6 hours.

Top container carriers by TEU capacity and their Hormuz posture (suspended, rerouting, limited, transiting), vessels-trapped count, trapped TEU, and per-carrier surcharge in USD per TEU. hormuzPosture is the operative field: 5+ carriers stopped within 60-day advisories drives the 'effectively closed' verdict. Hand-curated; refreshed weekly.

Petroline (Saudi Arabia to Yanbu) and Habshan-Fujairah (UAE to Gulf of Oman) - the main crude routes out of the Gulf without transiting Hormuz - with nameplate capacity in BPD and current utilisation. Hand-curated.

Open-market USD/IRR sell/buy rates in Toman (1 Toman = 10 Rial) and Rial, plus 24-hour and 7-day percentage deltas off the midRial - a proxy for civilian-side financial stress inside Iran. Refreshed hourly.
JSON archive of every daily brief: 3-6 bullets, a short summary, the day's Brent price plus 24-hour delta, and the day's transit count, keyed by UTC date. Rewritten every few hours.

params.description: A single UTC-dated brief (YYYY-MM-DD); 404 if missing.

operations.description: Bare-minimum payload for polling: Brent price, 24-hour change, transit and stranded counts, plus a verifiedAt anchor. 30-second edge cache.

Compares current state to a caller-provided anchor timestamp and raises a material flag once any of: 24h+ elapsed, Brent moved 1%+, any new event, any carrier posture change, transit delta 3+, or stranded delta 5+. 60-second edge cache.

params.description: Anchor ISO timestamp (required).
params.name: at

operations.description: SPR stocks from the EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report with the 4-week change so spike-vs-baseline reads correctly. Re-fetched daily 11:00 ET.

Cushing, Oklahoma WTI-delivery-hub inventories from the EIA weekly report - tracks the North-American crude balance independently of the Gulf-Coast / SPR picture; pairs with the Brent-WTI spread. Re-fetched daily 11:30 ET.
